FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

South Carolina fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need freshwater or saltwater coverage. A licence is required from the beach unless an exemption applies.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Recreational anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16 for ordinary recreational angling.
  • Saltwater anglers on licensed public piers or hired licensed charter vessels.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident freshwater 14-daynon resident14 consecutive days$11 USD
Non-resident freshwater annualnon resident1 year$35 USD
Non-resident saltwater 1-daynon resident1 day$10 USD
Non-resident saltwater 7-daynon resident7 consecutive days$35 USD
Non-resident saltwater annualnon resident1 year$75 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Shrimp baiting licence and tags · $500 USD
    Required for shrimp baiting during the authorised season.

Saltwater

Separate coverage applies. The boundary is usually US 17, but named exceptions change it.

Fishing with a guide or charter

A hired SCDNR-licensed saltwater charter vessel covers clients' individual saltwater licence requirement.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the required licence while you fish.
  • Nongame fishing devices can require extra permits, including for children.

How to buy

Use the SCDNR online licence service or a licence agent.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in South Carolina?

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need freshwater or saltwater coverage. A licence is required from the beach unless an exemption applies.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in South Carolina?

Non-resident freshwater 14-day: $11 USD; Non-resident freshwater annual: $35 USD; Non-resident saltwater 1-day: $10 USD; Non-resident saltwater 7-day: $35 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in South Carolina?

Use the SCDNR online licence service or a licence agent.
